41.question: Why are my cherry tomatoes splitting?
41.answer: Splitting or cracking is common in cherry tomatoes and is usually caused by inconsistent watering. A sudden downpour after a dry spell can cause the fruit to expand too quickly. Try to maintain even soil moisture.

44.question: Do I need more than one blueberry plant?
44.answer: Yes, for best results. While some varieties are self-pollinating, all blueberries produce larger berries and bigger yields when they can cross-pollinate with another blueberry variety.
